slides.headline: October 21, 1943: a provisional government was announced in Singapore, with eleven ministers and no territory to govern yet.
The Provisional Government of Azad Hind was announced, with 11 ministers and 8 INA representatives
slides.body: Formed as part of India's freedom movement, it operated as a government-in-exile structure during the final years of British colonial rule.

slides.headline: On its 75th anniversary in 2018, the tricolour was hoisted at Red Fort - the first time that had happened outside Independence Day.
slides.body: The commemoration marked the only time in India's modern history that the national flag was raised at that site on a date other than August 15, underscoring the formation's place in the institutional memory of the freedom movement.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat traces its institutions back to the full range of efforts that built toward independence.
slides.body: A government structured with ministers and representatives before a single day of formal independence showed that institutional planning for self-rule was underway years before 1947 arrived.
